findings.description: This abstract/base upgradeable contract declares state variables but does not include a `__gap` storage array. Without a gap, adding new state variables in a future version will shift the storage layout of derived contracts, causing storage collisions.
findings.recommendation:
Add a storage gap at the end of the contract:
```
uint256[50] private __gap;
```
The gap size should be chosen so that the total number of slots used by the contract equals a round number (e.g., 50).
